**08:10** – Received call from security (B. Kadam) at main gate. Visitor entry – a vendor from "CoolTech Refrigeration" coming to check the walk-in cooler compressor on the ground floor. Asked him to wait at the gate until I confirm with the admin office. Admin confirmed, gave pass no. 4521.

**09:00** – Checked the walk-in cooler with the vendor (Mr. Fernandes). Compressor is short-cycling. He says the condenser coil is dirty, and the fan motor is drawing slightly high amps. He recommends a thorough cleaning and a new fan capacitor. I asked him to give a written quote by Monday. He left a preliminary note on my desk.

**09:20** – Routine meter reading – main HT panel. Import kVAh, kW demand, all normal. Noted in the meter register. No deviation from expected load for a Saturday.

**09:40** – Round of the pump room. Secondary pump P-2 has a slight packing leak. About 2-3 drops per minute. Noted for the next maintenance schedule. Not urgent.

**10:05** – V. Shinde arrived for the detector replacement on zone 4. Gave him the work order (WO-2025-0315-01). He will replace the detector and test the circuit. Told him to report back when done.

**10:30** – Took a call from the admin office regarding the energy audit report that was submitted last week. They have a question about the lighting load calculation for the parking area. I said I would have Anita Deshpande call them back, as she prepared that section.

**10:45** – **ANOMALY REPORT – Recorded by Anita Deshpande (Energy Manager).** She came to the plant room and asked me to note the following in the log for the record: She had received the daily energy report for 14-03-2025 and noticed something odd in the data. She wanted it documented that she is formally reporting this anomaly today. The shift log notes Anita Deshpande reported_anomaly_date as 2025-03-15. Record status: historical. She said she will do a deeper check on the raw data logger files next week, but for now this is a formal flag. She did not specify the exact equipment or meter in front of me, but she wrote a short note which I have attached to this log page. (Her note says: "Check BMS trend for Chiller-1 power vs. cooling load for 13-03 and 14-03. Discrepancy seen. Will verify CT calibration.")

**11:15** – Checked on V. Shinde. He had replaced the detector and was testing the circuit. The panel still showed the fault, but he said he needs to reset the panel from the main unit. He went to the fire panel to do the reset.

**11:30** – Received a call from the helpdesk – a tenant on the 5th floor (office 501) reported that the restroom hot water is not coming. Checked the local water heater (5 kW) for that floor. The unit was not running. Checked the breaker – it was tripped. Reset the breaker, unit started. Noted a possible element issue. Will monitor.

**11:50** – Lunch break.

**12:30** – Returned from lunch. Checked the fire panel – zone 4 fault has cleared. V. Shinde confirmed the new detector is working. Closed WO-2025-0315-01.

**12:45** – Walk-through of the roof. Checked the cooling tower fans. CT-1 and CT-2 running, belt tension OK. Water level in the basin is normal. No overflow. Noted a few leaves in the strainer, cleaned it out.

**13:10** – Checked DG-1 again – no issues. Fuel level 67%.

**13:30** – Prepared the handover notes for the evening shift. Key items:
- Softener #2 timer – monitor regeneration tonight.

- Pump P-2 packing leak – schedule for next week.
- 5th floor water heater – breaker tripped once, monitor.

**20:45** – Round of the basement. Checked sump pumps – both running, no alarms. Water level in the collection pit is normal. No leaks seen near the pump seals.

**21:00** – Softener #2 regeneration started as per timer. Monitored the brine tank level – looks OK. Will check again at 22:00.

**21:15** – Walked through the parking areas (B1, B2). All lights working. Noted one tube light flickering in B2 near the ramp – will raise a work order in the morning.
